newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market near standstill - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market near standstill - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow and at a near standstill on Tuesday, USDA said. Limited sales slaughter steers and heifers $1.00 per cwt lower dressed basis, live basis - no sales. Buyer inquiry and demand moderate, seller interest light. Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights)
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1200 lbs 105.00, few with higher percentage Choice 106.00. ( weighted average 105.13 ).
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1125 lbs 105.00, few with higher percentage Choice 106.00. ( weighted average 105.06 ).
For The Wk - 12,300 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 64,300 Sm Pd Lst Yr - 4,900
